Scenario.server_up: when server_prep server install_apache emit server_up
Scenario.client_up: when client_prep client install_nettools emit client_up
Scenario.attacker_deps: when attacker_prep attacker install_build_deps emit attacker_deps
Scenario.attacker_stage: when attacker_deps attacker stage_flooder emit attacker_staged
Scenario.attacker_up: when attacker_staged attacker build_flooder emit attacker_up
Scenario.run_cookies: when server_up, client_up, attacker_up server set_cookies_off emit ready
Scenario.run_capture: when ready client capture emit capturing
Scenario.run_legit: when capturing client legit emit legit_up

Bindings.install_apache: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install apache2 >/tmp/dew-$nid-apache.log 2>&1 && sudo systemctl enable --now apache2 && sleep 2 && curl -sf http://localhost/ -o /dev/null"
Bindings.install_nettools: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install net-tools >/tmp/dew-$nid-net.log 2>&1 && command -v netstat >/dev/null"
Bindings.install_build_deps: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install make build-essential flex libnet1-dev libpcap-dev >/tmp/dew-$nid-deps.log 2>&1 && command -v make >/dev/null && command -v flex >/dev/null"
Bindings.build_flooder: bash -c "cd /usr/local/src/flooder && sudo make >/tmp/dew-$nid-build.log 2>&1 && sudo cp flooder /bin/ && test -x /bin/flooder"
Bindings.set_cookies_off: bash -c "sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=0 && sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=10000 && sysctl -n net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies | grep -qx 0"
Bindings.capture: bash -c "sudo rm -f /tmp/synflood-nocookie.pcap; sudo timeout 185 tcpdump -nn -i $expeth(server) -Z root -w /tmp/synflood-nocookie.pcap ip || [ $? -eq 124 ]"
Bindings.legit: bash -c "timeout 180 bash -c 'while true; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 http://server; sleep 1; done' || [ $? -eq 124 ]"
